result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom navigation all render consistently. Excluding the expected carousel edge-clipping and bottom viewport cutoff, only minor visual inconsistencies remain: the promo banner's decorative circles are clipped by the banner's right edge, and the third carousel card's title is truncated without an ellipsis hint (though this is edge clipping, excluded). Remaining minor observations: the notification bell's red dot indicator lacks sufficient affordance explanation, and the heart icon buttons on dark card images rely on a semi-transparent dark circle which is fine. Overall no critical or major visual defects detected.

issues.description: The decorative translucent circles in the green promo banner are cut off abruptly at the banner's right and bottom edges, creating a slightly unfinished look against the rounded card corners.
issues.suggestion: Either intentionally bleed the circles off-edge with overflow hidden (already the case) but adjust their position/opacity so the clipping looks deliberate, or add a subtle gradient fade at the banner edges.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right has a small red dot badge with no numeric count or label, which may be ambiguous for users and screen readers.
issues.suggestion: Add an accessible label (e.g., aria-label='Notifications, unread') and consider showing a count badge when there are unread notifications.

issues.description: The '€0 delivery' and '-100%' badge pills on the popular cards use different text colors (green vs dark) on white backgrounds inconsistently with the time badges on the carousel cards (dark text), creating slight inconsistency in badge styling.
issues.suggestion: Unify badge typography and color tokens across carousel and list cards for a consistent visual language.
